title: Systems Development Engineer, Controls Engineering
description_preview:
**Description**
 Amazon is looking for a Systems Development Engineer to support and maintain software solutions powering one of the world’s largest Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) enterprises. The RME Automation team supports the business through the integration and development of higher level software systems, realizing an Industry 4\.0 vision for the function. At a basic level, these systems link our low\-level automation systems with the cloud and we work at the cutting edge of all aspects of the automation pyramid, from device level to the enterprise level. The more complex systems are leveraging Machine Learning and Big Data to drive predictive actions, preventing downtime or defects in the material handling equipment and improving the Overall Equipment Effectiveness of the installations.
   

  

 This is a fantastic opportunity to work with some of the best engineers in the industry and help support and shape the direction of automation and machine learning systems within one of the world’s largest fulfillment networks.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a System Development Engineer within the CE team, the primary responsibilities include designing, developing, testing, and deploying new software, systems, infrastructure, networking or automation improvements, with a focus on CE Team infrastructures deployed in Amazon Web Services (AWS) and in the field.
   

  

* You solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context.
* You are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is consistently of high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices.
* You maintain SLA’s through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting.
* Your focus is on a major portion of existing or new team technology implementation (e.g., large or significant component, new enabling technology or process). You work with your team to ensure the highest level of support for the tools that the team owns.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description_preview:
**About The Company**
 Toyota Connected is a global leader in the development of innovative mobility solutions, leveraging big data, cloud computing, and advanced analytics to enhance the driving experience. Established in 2016, the company focuses on creating intelligent, connected vehicle technologies that improve safety, convenience, and personalization for Toyota and Lexus customers worldwide. Toyota Connected’s mission is to revolutionize mobility by integrating cutting\-edge data\-driven solutions that empower users and foster a more sustainable, connected future. With a commitment to diversity and inclusion, Toyota Connected strives to build a workplace that values unique perspectives and encourages innovation through collaboration and continuous learning.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Machine Learning Engineer to join our Labs team at Toyota Connected. In this role, you will utilize machine learning and statistical techniques to develop state\-of\-the\-art solutions for complex, often unsolved problems. Your work will directly impact the company’s bottom line by creating scalable, efficient, and innovative models that enhance our mobility services. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work on voice and text\-based projects, translating research into practical applications within a fast\-paced Agile environment. The ideal candidate will be deeply technical, results\-driven, and passionate about applying advanced machine learning methods to real\-world problems, contributing to the evolution of our intelligent mobility solutions.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in Machine Learning within a corporate environment
* Proficiency in programming with Python
* Experience working with TensorFlow or PyTorch
* Strong background in Natural Language Processing (NLP)
* Familiarity with algorithm design and complexity analysis
* Experience implementing solutions in cloud environments such as AWS or Azure (preferred)
* Experience designing and deploying Machine Learning pipelines in production settings (preferred)
* Strong decision\-making skills with the ability to analyze data, assess risks, and implement effective solutions
* Excellent problem\-solving skills with a creative approach to overcoming challenges
* Proven ability to learn and adopt new technologies, practices, and methodologies quickly
* Effective collaboration skills with cross\-functional teams including developers, designers, and product managers
* Ability to take ownership of projects, ensuring timely delivery and quality standards
* Results\-oriented mindset with a track record of achieving measurable outcomes


**Responsibilities**
* Translate complex academic research and white papers into practical, efficient code implementations
* Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code adhering to best practices and standards
* Share and promote architecture patterns and emerging technologies within the team
* Contribute to the design and review of ML system architecture through RFCs and technical discussions
* Participate actively in interview panels to evaluate and onboard junior Machine Learning Engineers
* Review merge requests and ensure code quality through comprehensive testing and validation
* Develop and execute the full machine learning lifecycle, including data cleansing, feature engineering, and iterative model tuning
* Build automated, scalable processes for large\-scale data analysis, model validation, and deployment
* Stay updated on the latest research methodologies and technological advancements, applying them to enhance existing solutions
* Collaborate within an Agile Scrum environment to prototype, design, and implement predictive models and algorithms
* Utilize statistical, machine learning, and deep learning techniques to create innovative solutions and drive research \& development efforts


**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation package with comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* Annual training budget of $2,500 for professional development
* Unlimited paid time off and flexible work arrangements to promote work\-life balance
* Home office stipend of $1,000 to support ergonomic remote work setup
* Four months of paid parental leave to support new parents
* Adoption assistance of $5,000 for standard adoptions or $6,000 for special needs adoptions
* 401(k) plan with a generous company match that vests immediately
* Vehicle discounts on Toyota and Lexus models, along with vehicle allowances
* Participation in annual hackathons to foster innovation and creativity
* Wellness stipend of $1,000 to support mental and physical health
* Free catered lunches onsite, with healthy options and occasional “cheat” days
* Access to fully stocked Nespresso bars for coffee and tea
* Casual dress code fostering a relaxed work environment
* Free covered parking for convenience and protection from weather elements


 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 Toyota Connected is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, or other protected characteristics. We are dedicated to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process to ensure equal access and opportunity for all candidates. If you require any accommodations, please contact our recruiting team to discuss your needs. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and are essential to our continued success.

title: Software Engineer
description_preview:
**About The Company**
 Valon is building the AI\-native operating system for regulated finance, starting with mortgage servicing.
   

  

 We're a Series C company backed by a16z, transforming industries that others have written off as too complex to innovate.
   

  

 Rather than build on top of broken legacy systems, we took a different approach: we built and operate our own mortgage servicing business managing $110\+ billion in loans. This wasn't the end goal, it was how we deeply understood the complexity needed to build software that actually works in regulated industries.
   

  

 The results speak for themselves. We've transformed mortgage servicing from a 0% margin business into 60%\+ margins while dramatically improving customer experience. Major enterprise contracts are now deploying across the industry.
   

  

 ValonOS is our unified platform that makes every process structured and programmable and it is perfectly positioned for the AI era. When everything flows through one system with rich data, AI agents don't just automate tasks, they continuously improve entire operations. Mortgage servicing is just the beginning of our vision to transform regulated industries and beyond.
   

  

**Engineering at Valon**
 Our engineering team is here to power the software ecosystem to disrupt one of the most outdated and regulated spaces in the financial sector \- the mortgage industry. We’ve built out the foundation of a modern mortgage servicing platform that can accurately handle billions of dollars at scale, but we’re just getting started. At Valon, we want you to do the best work of your life. You'll be surrounded by a tight\-knit community of exceptional people from places like Stripe, Jane Street, Meta, and Google who care deeply about their work and each other. Our problem space is complex, but you’ll get a lot of autonomy so that you can learn quickly, execute effectively, and deliver the highest level of business impact. Our tech stack is built on Python, React, Docker, Kubernetes, and Google Cloud Platform.
   

  

 Our headquarters are in New York City, and this year, we’re excited to open a new office in San Francisco. Plus, we fully support remote work!
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Responsible for learning new concepts and technologies quickly and apply them to challenging problems.
* Designing and building robust and extensible infrastructure to handle evolving and complex federal, state, and agency regulations.
* Dive deep to understand the inner workings of a highly complex industry.
* Work with Product and Design to define the best experience for our customers.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description_preview:
(No H1B or OPT Visa Sponsorship will be provided).
 



  





**About Shelf:** 




 There is no AI strategy without a data strategy. While generative AI is now mission\-critical for most enterprises, nearly 90 percent of AI initiatives fail to reach production. The primary reason is poor data quality. Bad data leads directly to unreliable outputs, undermining trust and ROI.
 



 Shelf exists to solve this problem. We unlock AI readiness by providing the core infrastructure enterprises need to deploy GenAI at scale with confidence. Our platform improves the accuracy and reliability of GenAI systems by identifying and eliminating poor\-quality data in documents and files before that data ever reaches a large language model. The result is better answers, faster deployment, and measurable Day 1 ROI.
 



  





 We work with leading global organizations including Amazon, Mayo Clinic, American Family Insurance, and Nespresso to operationalize their AI strategies. Shelf partners with major enterprise technology providers including Microsoft, Salesforce, Snowflake, Databricks, and OpenAI to bring trusted GenAI solutions into production environments.
 



  





 Our mission is simple and ambitious: to empower humanity with better answers everywhere.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 The Forward Deployed Engineer is a highly autonomous, customer\-facing technical leader responsible for delivering proof\-of\-value engagements with enterprise prospects. This role sits at the intersection of data modeling, ontology design, and hands\-on engineering execution, with direct impact on revenue and customer adoption.
 



  





 You will independently lead rapid 3–5 day pilot engagements that demonstrate Shelf’s value, solve real customer data challenges, and convert into closed deals. These pilots require deep understanding of enterprise data architectures, the ability to design high\-quality semantic and ontology\-driven models, and the technical execution skills to configure and implement working solutions quickly.
 



  





 Reporting to the Field CTO, you will partner closely with Account Executives across the full sales lifecycle, owning the technical evaluation and POV phases. You will also support expansion opportunities within existing customers as part of Shelf’s land\-and\-expand growth strategy. During engagements, you will collaborate directly with the Engineering team, while also contributing back reusable templates, ontology patterns, and best practices that scale across the organization. This is a rare opportunity to work at the cutting edge of AI and data quality, embedding directly with enterprise customers to prove value in days, not months.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 




**Technical Depth:** 




 Strong expertise in data modeling, enterprise data platforms, and ETL or data pipeline design. Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, or semantic technologies is strongly preferred, though exceptional data modeling experience can substitute.
 



  





**Forward\-Deployed Ownership:** 




 Comfort operating independently with enterprise prospects, leading complex technical engagements with minimal supervision.
 



  





**Hands\-On Problem Solving:** 




 Ability to write Python scripts, automate workflows, and leverage modern AI coding tools to rapidly build, test, and iterate solutions during live customer engagements.
 



  





**Customer\-Facing Excellence:** 




 Clear, confident communication with both technical and business stakeholders. Comfortable presenting solutions, incorporating feedback, and adapting in real time.
 



  





**Rapid Execution:** 




 Thrives in fast\-paced pilot environments with tight timelines. Able to deliver measurable value in 3–5 day cycles.
 



  





**Sales\-Oriented Mindset:** 




 Understands enterprise sales motions and is motivated by converting technical success into closed revenue.
 



  





**Continuous Learning:** 




 Stays current on GenAI trends, data technologies, and modern engineering practices.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead independent proof\-of\-value engagements with enterprise prospects, designing custom ontologies and delivering working solutions within 3–5 days
* Conduct technical discovery and present solutions to data engineers, enterprise architects, and AI or ML teams
* Own the technical evaluation and POV phases while supporting Account Executives throughout the sales cycle
* Collaborate directly with Engineering on complex or custom implementations during pilots
* Support deals through closing and early onboarding in partnership with Customer Success
* Contribute to customer expansion efforts within existing accounts
* Work with the Field CTO to develop reusable ontology templates, POV frameworks, and best practices



  





**Qualifications:** 



* 7–10\+ years of experience in technical pre\-sales, data engineering, solutions architecture, or similar customer\-facing technical roles
* Strong background in data modeling, data platforms, and ETL or pipeline architectures
* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, or semantic technologies strongly preferred
* Proficiency in Python scripting and workflow automation
* Hands\-on experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot
* Deep understanding of cloud and enterprise data platforms including AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Proven record of success in customer\-facing technical roles with clear sales impact
* Strong presentation and communication skills across technical and executive audiences
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
* Experience in B2B SaaS, AI or ML platforms, or data quality solutions preferred



  





**Success Metrics (First 18 Months):** 



* Achieve a 70 percent or higher conversion rate from pilot to closed deal
* Deliver 8–10 high\-quality proof\-of\-value engagements per quarter within 3–5 day timelines
* Contribute meaningfully to ARR growth through new customer acquisition and account expansion
* Consistently deliver high\-quality ontologies and technical solutions that meet enterprise standards



  





**What We Offer:** 



* Competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits
* Clear expectations and transparent communication
* Strong alignment around values and company goals

**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms in either an academic or industry setting.
* 2 years of experience developing Android or iOS applications, programming in Java or Swift/Objective\-C.
* 2 years of experience in Bluetooth development or developing software for Wearable Devices.


**About the job** 
 Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
   

  

 As a part of the AR Glasses team, you will be building glasses that provide all\-day helpfulness in use cases like translation, navigation, photography and AI assistance. In this role, you will be a part of the SonicXP team (go/sonicxp\-charter) and will be responsible for several key features including translation, the media player, and the phone call experience on glasses. Your mission is to empower users with delightful glasses experiences that amplify the power of speech and sound.
   

  

 You will be responsible for delivering great translation experiences for both Android and iOS users of XR glasses, as this role is for a mobile developer with experience in either iOS or Android (or both). You will likely contribute to both platforms over time.For decades, the computing revolution has reshaped our world driven by
   

  

 breakthroughs in compute, connectivity, mobile, and now, AI. Google's XR team is at the forefront of the next major leap – the convergence of AI and XR. This is more than just new devices – it's about reimagining how we interact with the world around us. We're building a future where
   

  

 lightweight XR devices like smart glasses and headsets pair with helpful AI to augment human intelligence, offering personalized, conversational, and contextually aware experiences.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
   

  

 US: $147000 \- $211000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Learn more about benefits at Google .
   

  

* Adapt, build, and launch first\-party applications, experiences for Android/iOS phones paired with next\-generation wearables using familiar Android/iOS development tools.
* Leverage generative AI tools to accelerate the end\-to\-end engineering life\-cycle, including rapid prototyping, automated test generation, and code optimization for wearable experiences.
* Ensure XR support feels native and idiomatic to the platform, leveraging modern mobile development practices (e.g., Model\-View\-ViewModel (MVVM) and the best of the Glasses Software Development Kit (SDK).
* Work closely with UX and Product Manager to define, prototype, and test experiences to discover what experiences users value the most and how to improve the experiences to provide more value to users.
* Collaborate with other Google teams (Google Translate, etc.) to build features that leverage the best of Google products and services.

title: Associate Engineer - Land Development (Underfill Opportunity for Assistant Engineer)
description_preview:
**Description**
 The Public Works Department, Land Development Division, is recruiting an Associate Engineer I/II to provide technical assistance and help ensure compliance with engineering standards and regulations. This position may be underfilled as an Assistant Engineer for candidates who meet the lower\-level qualifications, with progression to the Associate I/II level upon successful completion of defined benchmarks.
 
****This recruitment will close at 05:00 p.m. (PST) on Tuesday, June 9, 2026****
 This role offers work\-life balance with a 4/10 schedule, giving you three\-day weekends each week. Depending on departmental needs, your flex day will be either Monday or Friday, offering additional time to rest and recharge.
   

  

 Salary: Associate Engineer II: $108,638\.40 \- $152,921\.60
   

  

 Associate Engineer I: $103,459\.20 \- $145,662\.40
   

  

 Assistant Engineer (Underfill): $89,356\.80 \- $125,840\.00
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 We are seeking a skilled
 **Associate Engineer I/II** 
 to join the Public Works Department. This professional position involves performing engineering work in the planning, design, and construction of municipal infrastructure projects. The Associate Engineer will assist with reviewing plans, specifications, and cost estimates; coordinating with contractors and agencies; and ensuring compliance with standards and regulations. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the City’s Land Development projects while gaining valuable experience.
   

  

 Applicants who do not meet the Associate Engineer I/II qualifications may be considered for an underfill as
 **Assistant Engineer** 
 , depending on experience. If hired at the Assistant Engineer level, the employee will perform similar duties under closer supervision, with opportunities for mentorship, training, and promotion to the Associate level upon successful demonstration of skills and performance. If the position is underfilled, the salary offered will be commensurate with the lower classification. Minimum qualifications and salaries are listed in the job descriptions below.
   

  

**Job Descriptions**
 Click the following links to access the complete classification descriptions, including the experience, education, and physical and mental requirements for this job. Associate Engineer I/II and Assistant Engineer .
   

  

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**
 The ideal candidate is a motivated and detail\-oriented professional with a solid foundation in civil engineering principles and practices. They should have experience supporting infrastructure projects through tasks such as plan review, cost estimation, and field inspections. Knowledge of engineering standards, construction methods, and local regulations is essential, along with proficiency in engineering software and strong analytical skills. The candidate should be organized, collaborative, and eager to learn, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively. This position is perfect for an emerging engineer committed to professional growth and to contributing to the City’s public works and capital improvement projects.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
**Associate Engineer I/II**
* Bachelor's Degree in c ivil engineering, electrical engineering, or related field
* 3 years of progressively responsible engineering experience
* A valid and current E.I.T. certification issued by the State of California


**Assistant Engineer**
* Bachelor's Degree in c ivil engineering, electrical engineering, or related field, OR equivalent work experience
* 1 year of progressively responsible engineering experience OR, equivalent related work experience; or an equivalent combination of training and experience.


**Licenses; Certificates; Special Requirements:**
* Associate Engineer I: A valid and current E.I.T. certification issued by the State of California
* Associate Engineer II: A valid and current registration as a Professional Civil or Electrical Engineer with the State Licensing Board.
* A valid California driver’s license and the ability to maintain insurability under the City’s vehicle insurance policy.


**DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS**
 Associate Engineer II : Is the registered professional engineering\-level in the engineering class series. Under direction, incumbents are responsible for performing a variety of public works engineering activities, including managing assigned projects, initiating communications and providing reliable information to engineering management regarding public works projects, compliance review, inspection and reviewing the work of design consultants and contractors to ensure that projects are completed on time within budget, and other duties as assigned.
   

  

 Associate Engineer I : Is the journey\-level, non\-registered engineering class in the engineering class series. Under direc­tion, incumbents are responsible for performing a variety of public works engineering activities, including initiating com­munications and providing reliable information to engineering management regarding public works projects, compliance review and inspection and reviewing the work of design consultants and contractors to ensure that projects are completed within budget and on time. Incumbents in this class shall promote automatically to Associate Engineer II once a professional engineering license is obtained.
   

  

**Assistant Engineer**
 Assistant Engineer is the entry\-level, non\-registered engineering class in the professional engineering class series. Initially under direct supervision, an incumbent performs the more routine professional engineering assignments. With experience, the work becomes progressively more diversified and difficult and requires increasing independence.
   

  

 Assistant Engineer is distinguished from Associate Engineer in that incumbents in the latter class perform a variety of routine to moderately difficult professional\-level engineering work requiring an E.I.T. certificate.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 The City of Moreno Valley prides itself on delivering quality service to our residents and businesses efficiently and effectively through Collaboration, Innovation, Customer Service, and Human\-Centric Design. Strategically located in Southern California’s Inland Empire, Moreno Valley is the second\-largest city in Riverside County and is close to major hubs such as Los Angeles, Orange County, and San Diego. This spacious, thriving, and diverse City has a population of over 200,000 residents and offers a variety of business opportunities. For additional information regarding the City, please click here.
   

  

**About The Public Works Department**
 The Public Works department is responsible for public works administration, city engineering, maintenance of public facilities located within the street right\-of\-way, design and construction of City\-built capital improvements, and administration of traffic facilities, providing electric service to new development in residential, commercial and industrial areas, and related activities.
   

  

 For more information about the Public Works Department, please click here .
   

  

**THE SELECTION PROCESS**
 Applicants possessing the
 **MOST DESIRABLE** 
 qualifications at each level, based on a screening of required application materials, including the completed Supplemental Questionnaire, will be invited to continue in the selection process. The City of Moreno Valley prioritizes and is committed to continuously providing a workplace where equal employment opportunity is afforded to all people.
   

  

**Recruitment Process:** 
 Human Resources (HR) reviews all application materials to determine whether candidates meet the established minimum and preferred qualifications after the position closes. Those who qualify will be advanced to the next stage of the recruitment process. All applicants will receive email notifications regarding their status.
   

  

**Application Screening**
 Applications and supplemental materials will be reviewed to identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the position's essential requirements. Only those applicants who meet the criteria outlined in the job bulletin will advance to the next phase of the selection process.
   

  

**Video Appraisal Interview**
 Applicants may complete a self\-guided video interview by recording responses to a series of structured questions. These questions are designed to assess each candidate's qualifications and suitability for the position. There is no live interviewer or proctor; candidates will record their answers independently and submit the videos for evaluation.
   

  

**Technical Interview**
 Selected applicants will be invited to participate in a structured technical interview designed to evaluate job\-related knowledge, problem\-solving abilities, and proficiency in key competencies required for the position. Candidates will respond to a series of standardized questions, and their performance will be assessed using predetermined evaluation criteria to ensure a fair and consistent appraisal process.
   

  

**Based on the Department's needs, the selection procedures listed above may be modified. All candidates will be notified of any changes in the selection procedure.**
**Eligible List:** 
 Once the appraisal is complete, HR will establish an eligible list of candidates. Candidates placed on the eligible list may be referred to a selection interview to be considered for present and future vacancies.
   

  

**DISCLAIMERS**
 The City of Moreno Valley is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. The City of Moreno Valley prioritizes and is committed to continuously providing a workplace where equal employment opportunity is afforded to all people. As part of this commitment, the City of Moreno Valley will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations.
   

  

 If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the interview process, please contact Human Resources at hr@moval.org or (951\) 413\-3045\.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description_preview:
**Head of Engineering / Founding Engineer** 




 Build the agentic operating system for accelerating clinical trials. Own the technical vision from day one. Write code, shape architecture, and lay the foundation for a company that will accelerate the drug development lifecycle and get life\-changing therapies to patients faster. This is a hands\-on founding role.
 



  





**The Mission** 




 This company is building the first agentic operating platform purpose\-built for clinical trial operations. They partner with clinical trial companies make them more financially resilient, automate administrative burden, and augment people\-centric workflows. The goal is simple but profound: accelerate the drug development lifecycle and make a tangible impact on how quickly promising therapies reach the patients who need them.
 



  





 The platform is being developed in close collaboration with design partners, ensuring that every feature solves a real problem faced every day. The company is backed by top\-tier early\-stage investors with track records of backing Palantir, Lyft, Gitlab, and Square.
 



  





**The Role** 




 The company is looking for a founding engineer to own the technical direction and accelerate product development alongside design partners. This is not a managerial role that has been removed from the codebase. This is a hands\-on building position—writing code daily while simultaneously shaping the architecture and hiring decisions that will define the company for years to come.
 



  





 As the first engineering hire, you will set the standard. You will make foundational decisions about the stack, the development process, and the culture of the engineering organization.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* ***Own the Full Stack***
 : Take end\-to\-end ownership of the technical architecture—frontend, backend, AI/LLM integration, and infrastructure. Every line of code you write will directly shape the product.
* ***Build in Lockstep with Customers***
 : Work directly with the CEO and design partners to translate real\-world clinical trial site needs into product features. You will ship quickly, iterate based on feedback, and close the loop between customer input and delivered value.
* ***Built AI Agents***
 : Design and build agents and systems that don't just retrieve information but actually automate complex, people\-centric workflows. You will decide how the platform reasons, acts, and learns over time.
* ***Make Foundational Decisions***
 : Choose the technologies, patterns, and tradeoffs that will enable the platform to scale from pilot customers to industry\-wide adoption. These decisions will echo for a decade.



  





**Who You Are** 



* ***1\+ Years of Software Engineering Experience***
 : You have shipped production software and understand what it takes to build something that users depend on.
* ***Hands\-On with LLMs and Agentic Systems***
 : You have built with large language models and are fluent in the emerging patterns of agentic AI. You know how to move from prototype to production.
* ***Proficient with AI\-Assisted Developmen***
 t: You leverage tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and the modern AI development stack to maximize velocity without sacrificing quality.
* ***Strong Full\-Stack Fundamentals***
 : You are comfortable across the entire stack and can context\-switch between frontend polish, backend reliability, and infrastructure decisions.
* ***Bias Toward Shipping***
 : You believe in progress over perfection. You are comfortable with ambiguity and know how to make tradeoffs to deliver value now while laying groundwork for later.
* ***Excited by Healthcare and Life Sciences Impact***
 : You don't need domain experience in clinical trials, but you are genuinely motivated by the opportunity to accelerate drug development and improve patient outcomes.



  





**Why Join** 



* ***Ground\-Floor Equity***
 : This is founding\-team equity in a company targeting a $50 billion\+ market that currently has no dominant software solution. The upside is significant.
* ***Deep Domain Expertise***
 : The founder has deep domain expertise from leading M\&A deals in clinical research and understands the market intimately. You won't be guessing—you'll be building for a space the leadership knows cold.
* ***Strong Validation***
 : Industry leaders in the clinical trial category are already on the company's Advisory Board, providing validation, connections, and strategic guidance.
* ***Clear Expansion Path***
 : The initial product wedge is clear and defensible, with a visible path to expanding across the entirety of clinical trial operations. You'll be building the platform.



  





**The Stack** 




 You will have significant influence over the technical stack. Current thinking includes:
 


* ***Frontend***
 : React, TypeScript
* ***Backend***
 : Python, Node.js
* ***AI/ML***
 : Modern LLM tooling, agentic frameworks, vector databases
* ***Infrastructure***
 : Cloud\-native, designed for scale from day one



  





**Location \& Culture** 




 This role is based in New York City. The team believes in the power of in\-person collaboration during this founding stage—you'll be working side by side with the CEO and early design partners, moving fast and building something that matters.
 



  





**Ready to build the operating system for clinical trials?**

 New York, NY (Hybrid – 3 days in\-office)
 



  





 One of our hiring partners is looking to hire a 3\+ year Full Stack Engineer to join their growing team in NYC. **About the Company:** 




 There is a quiet revolution happening in healthcare, and it is not being waged in a lab or a legislative chamber. It is being fought in spreadsheets, outdated directories, and the manual, error\-ridden processes that determine which doctors patients can actually see.
 



  





 The company already has product\-market fit, real customers, and a clear line of sight to massive scale. Now, they are building the engineering team that will take them there.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 This is not a maintenance role. This is not a ticket\-taker role. This is a seat at the table for an engineer with 3\+ years of experience who is ready to build like a founder.
 



  





 The company is seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer to join a small, high\-agency team rebuilding the core of their network adequacy platform from the ground up. You will not be siloed to a single view or service. You will touch the entire stack—from React components that shape how customers experience complex data, to Django services that execute the logic determining whether a patient in rural Montana has access to a pediatric endocrinologist.
 



  





 You will work alongside senior engineers who believe that mentorship is not a distraction from the work, but the work itself. You will have direct access to leadership, clear ownership of meaningful features, and the latitude to make technical decisions that will outlast your tenure.
 



  





**What You’ll Do:** 



* Own features end\-to\-end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration. No handoffs. No ambiguity.
* Contribute to the full rewrite of the company’s core adequacy application—modernizing a React frontend and refactoring backend services for scale, performance, and maintainability.
* Help scale the company’s adequacy calculations from a single\-state prototype to a 50\-state enterprise\-grade engine.
* Partner closely with product, data, and engineering peers to define scope, challenge assumptions, and ship well\-architected solutions.
* Write code that is clean, tested, and durable—code you would be proud to explain to a future teammate three years from now.
* Leverage modern AI tooling not as a crutch, but as a force multiplier, accelerating both velocity and output quality.
* Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and the ongoing refinement of how this team builds software.



  





**Who You Are:** 



* You have 3 years of professional full\-stack engineering experience. You are past the “learning the ropes” phase and entering the “I can own this” phase.
* You are genuinely fluent in modern frontend development. React is your default, not a checkbox.
* You have built production software on the backend using a framework like Django, Rails, or equivalent. If that framework is Django, move to the front of the line.

* **Your impact will be visible.**

 The senior engineers on this team have trained engineers who now lead teams at high\-growth startups. They take this seriously.

 Adequacy is not a CRUD app. It involves complex logic, large datasets, and performance constraints that reward thoughtful architecture.
* **The mission is real.** 
 This is not healthcare\-washing. This is a company fixing a specific, measurable, high\-stakes problem that affects millions of Americans.
* **The team is the perk.** 
 Low politics. High trust. People who would rather ship than argue about who owns what.



  





**Compensation \& Benefits:** 



* Meaningful equity ownership—because builders should share in what they build.
* Comprehensive health insurance, commuter benefits, and a stipend for home office equipment.
* Unlimited PTO, with a team that actually takes it and encourages you to do the same.

* You prefer deep individual focus and find customer\-facing time draining.

* **Small, senior, sharp**

title: Senior Electrical Engineer
reject_reason: Title disqualified: Senior Electrical Engineer
description_preview:
Dexmate is building the foundation for physical AI — combining a new generation of robots with a universal Physical AI OS, making robots as easy to build and deploy as software. Today, robotics is fragmented, slow, and closed: most builders are forced to reinvent the same stack again and again, and most ideas never make it past the prototype stage. We exist to change that. Our mission is to democratize robotics by lowering the barrier to entry, delivering a plug\-and\-play platform for developers, researchers, and enterprises, and cultivating an open ecosystem that accelerates the evolution of physical AI. If you want to help shape the next layer of human capability — and believe the future of robotics should be built together, not in isolation — we'd love to build it with you.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to design, develop, and validate the core electrical subsystems of our general\-purpose robot platforms. You will own power electronics, motor drive circuits, sensor integration, and PCB design — from schematic through bring\-up to production\-ready hardware.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role. You will make architecture decisions, drive subsystems end\-to\-end, and be accountable for hardware that ships on every unit.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end design of power electronics subsystems: battery management, power distribution, protection circuits, and DC\-DC conversion
* Design and validate motor drive circuits for high\-performance actuation, including FOC/BLDC/PMSM control topologies
* Design sensor integration circuits for IMUs, encoders, hall\-effect sensors, force/torque sensors, and thermal sensors
* Create schematics and multi\-layer PCB layouts using industry\-standard EDA tools (e.g., Altium, Cadence Allegro, KiCad), owning the full cycle from concept through layout review, prototype bring\-up, and production release
* Perform circuit simulation (LTspice or equivalent) and systematic hardware validation using oscilloscopes, current probes, power analyzers, and spectrum analyzers
* Apply EMI/EMC design principles from the start; support FCC, CE, and UL certification as we move toward commercial deployment
* Drive DFM/DFA decisions to ensure designs are manufacturable and testable at production scale
* Instrument boards and conduct board\-level bring\-up, power\-on sequencing, and subsystem verification
* Collaborate daily with firmware engineers on hardware/software interfaces and with mechanical engineers on physical integration and thermal constraints
* Document designs with the rigor required for CM handoff and engineering review


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of electrical engineering experience in robotics, industrial automation, automotive, or consumer electronics — with at least one product shipped to production
* Hands\-on PCB design experience in industry\-standard EDA tools (Altium, Cadence Allegro, KiCad, or equivalent) for complex, multi\-layer boards with high\-speed digital, power, and mixed\-signal on the same design
* Proven experience designing power electronics: BMS, power distribution, protection circuits, or DC\-DC conversion
* Motor drive design experience — BLDC, PMSM, or servo drive circuits, ideally with FOC topology
* Strong bench skills: oscilloscope, current probe, power analyzer, logic/spectrum analyzer, signal integrity debug
* Ability to read and interpret electronic circuit diagrams; comfortable integrating sensors and actuators
* Experience with DFM/DFA and working directly with contract manufacturers
* Experience designing complex multilayer PCBs (8\+ layers), including controlled impedance routing, mixed\-signal design, and high\-speed differential pairs


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience taking a product through FCC, CE, or UL certification, including EMC pre\-compliance testing
* Functional safety design experience (ISO 26262, IEC 61508, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with embedded firmware at the hardware/firmware boundary — enough to co\-debug with firmware engineers without needing translation
* Experience with high\-density or thermally\-constrained PCB layouts
* Background in production test fixture design and manufacturing ramp
* Proficiency in Python or similar scripting for test automation
* Hands\-on use of AI\-assisted EDA or coding tools in your design workflow
